correctness.rationale: The coordinatewise automorphism average is feasible and preserves or reduces the convex SLEM. Tensor Laplacian eigenspaces indexed by nonempty coordinate subsets give the exact extremal eigenvalues. Independent spectral- and budget-based lower bounds attain equality at a common coordinate decrement. Invariant uniqueness follows from equality in the active bounds. For any unrestricted optimum, every single-coordinate contrast is a saturated top eigenvector after averaging; equality in the Rayleigh bound forces it to be a top eigenvector of the original chain. This determines every fiber Laplacian and every edge probability, proving unrestricted uniqueness. An independent standalone implementation passed 362 assertion groups over 19 finite graph instances. The proof establishes the infinite family; tests alone do not.

value.rationale: This is an exact classification of optimal weights, one-step spectral contraction and the holding/nonholding frontier on all anisotropic multi-alphabet Hamming networks, a natural class for coordinate-resampling Markov chains. The strengthened assertion is global rigidity of every unrestricted optimizer, where basic graph-symmetry reduction guarantees only an invariant representative. The sharp 3-factor reciprocal-size boundary isolates genuine heterogeneous critical arrays (2,3,6) and (2,4,4). It does not rely on numerical small gains or an arbitrary graph slice; equal-factor formulas are credited as known.
